title: Signed builds — one-time reinstall
body:
Helix releases are now signed with a private key — every update is
  verifiably built from the official repo, and fake or tampered APKs can no longer install over the real
  app. Android sees the new signature as a different publisher, so this one time the update button can't
  install it for you. Export your settings first (Settings → Backup), uninstall Helix, grab the fresh APK
  from GitHub, and import your backup — updates flow normally from then on. Release notes on GitHub now
  show an actual changelog too, instead of a bare commit number.

title: Upload fix + MultiACE overhaul
body:
Fixed uploads timing out on big G-code files. The timeout now scales
  with file size, so large prints reach the printer reliably. New Save button next to Upload lets you
  save G-code to your phone for manual upload through the web UI. MultiACE tab rewritten against the real
  multiACE 0.99.2b status format: lanes now show spool colors and RFID info, dryer status with humidity,
  and the active unit. Dryer controls now use commands that work on ACE Pro V1 (previously ACE 2-only).
  If the tab shows nothing, update multiACE on your printer first (ACE_UPDATE_APPLY).

title: Big slicer update
body:
Multicolor prints now slice with their real colors. Pick a plate on
  multi-plate files. New Print Preprocessing popup before sending: choose printer, remap tool heads, see
  per-color filament use. Open .3mf/.stl files straight from your browser or file manager. New Supports,
  Infill, Ironing and Brim options on the prepare screen. Plus: fixed the tab bar hiding behind Android's
  navigation buttons.

body: Bell here shows changelogs and news. Thanks for testing.
